headline: Edison International to Release Q2 Earnings: What's in Store?
summary: EIX's Q2 results are likely to reflect grid investments, rate-case support, rising demand and tighter cost controls.

headline: WEC Energy Group (WEC) Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates
summary: WEC Energy (WEC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +13.75% and -2.26%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
